title: Trade config v1.1 — what Scout hands to Judge; the only thing the engine reads

schema_version.description: 1.1 adds schedule.resolution; 1.0 configs are read unchanged (daily)

experiment.description: Linear ticket identifier once known (e.g. NOS-14); Scout may leave it empty on round 1

round.description: framework attempt number within the experiment

hypothesis.description: one line, plain words: the alpha claim

framework.description: plain-words description of how the trade captures the hypothesis (what is ranked, over what lookback, who is bought/sold, how much, how often)

min_mdv_usd.description: 21-day median daily $ volume to be eligible

params.description: tunables referenced from the signal/positions as "$name"; Judge sweeps inside `range` and selects on the calibration window only

range.description: [min, max] Judge may sweep; omit to pin the value

name.description: field op: one of the data fields in the spec

in.description: single-input ops: the series to transform

window.description: rolling/ewm/lag/diff/pct_change: integer bars — days, or hours at resolution 1h — or "$param"

output.description: the series to rank; HIGHER = more attractive to be LONG

quantile.description: quantile: fraction per side (0.2 = top/bottom fifth)

side_gross_pct.description: target gross per side as % of notional before caps (50 = 1x total gross)

per_name_bps.description: alternative to side_gross_pct: fixed bps of notional per name

hedge_btc.description: Judge's engine hedges beta to BTC; set false only for a deliberate directional test

resolution.description: the grid the signal, positions and schedule live on: daily rows at 00:00 UTC, or hourly rows (bar fields become the hour's bar; windows count hours)

rebalance.description: how often targets are recomputed; 1d 2d 3d 1w 2w at resolution 1d, 1h 2h 4h 6h 8h 12h 1d at resolution 1h (entries at UTC hours divisible by the interval)

holding_days.description: resolution 1d: how long a position is held after entry (default = rebalance interval)

delay_days.description: resolution 1d: execution delay after the signal date (engine always adds the point-in-time lag; this is extra)

rebalance_hours.description: resolution 1h with rebalance 1h: enter only at these UTC hours each day (time-of-day ideas); flat between holds

holding_hours.description: resolution 1h: how long a position is held after entry (default = rebalance interval)

delay_hours.description: resolution 1h: extra execution delay in hours

alternatives.description: optional alternative rules Judge may also try in the sweep (selection on calibration only)

signal.output.description: other step outputs that are legitimate rankings of the same idea

notes.description: what Scout expects, what would kill the idea, anything Judge should know
